sources.name: Simple English Wiktionary via Wiktextract/Kaikki
sources.notes: Pinned E03 morphology/usage review source. On 2026-10-19 Platform CI observed that the mutable Kaikki raw URL had advanced from compressed-source SHA-256 59c8264d5b51f1984ca869311cbc14d1f50ccbe2674a88fbbe2b124f8dba5ebd to c825b1b10d5711668898534b1d437f94bed7a88fb233e84a05d3be6dd0e1df32. The new compressed-source checksum is pinned explicitly rather than bypassing checksum validation. Exact upstream dump/extraction metadata was not independently verifiable during this refresh, so this observation is not publication evidence. No already-published lexical record is auto-upgraded; publishAllowed remains false and refreshed candidate output requires comparison plus lexicographer/editorial review before any publication.

sources.name: Vietnamese Wiktionary English entries via Wiktextract/Kaikki
sources.notes: Pinned E03 review source: Vietnamese Wiktionary dump 2026-09-01, extracted by Kaikki/Wiktextract on 2026-10-03. On 2026-10-17 Platform CI observed that the mutable Kaikki raw URL had advanced to compressed-source SHA-256 7d803b15648fdec9be8eb2debfc507e12a2b17685ec383526fd02fe7e45e780f. The source metadata was verified before refreshing this pin; checksum validation remains mandatory. No already-published lexical record is auto-upgraded, publishAllowed remains false, and refreshed candidate output remains review-only until it is compared with the previous reviewed snapshot and receives the required lexical/editorial review.

sources.name: Tatoeba sentence corpus
sources.notes: Published E06 Tatoeba records retain their original per-record weekly-export-2026-09-26 provenance. On 2026-10-03 CI observed checksum drift only in eng_sentences.tsv; the Vietnamese sentence and EN↔VI link files remained byte-identical. The explicit refresh review compared CI #577 vs #581 artifacts and found the same 16,267 filtered candidates and the exact same 300 selected pair IDs/texts in the same order. The refreshed English checksum is accepted for future candidate generation without mutating already-published pairs.
